Mission and objectives

The World Health Organization is a specialized agency of the United Nations Public Health Organization established in 1948. The objective of the World Health Organization shall be the attainment by all peoples of the highest possible level of health.
World Health Organization achieves its goals by performing its essential functions:
1. Take a leadership role in key health issues and create partnerships when joint action is needed;
2. Set research priorities and encourage the acquisition, application and dissemination of useful knowledge;
3. Setting standards and criteria and encouraging and monitoring them;
4. Develop ethical and evidence-based policies
5. Provide technical support, be an agent of change and build institutional capacity in a sustainable way;
6. Monitor health status and assess health trends.
Context
WHO AFRO is strengthening its results-based planning, resource management and decision-support capabilities through improved planning processes and AI-enabled analytical tools.

This includes the Strategic Forecasting and Resource Optimization Platform, funded by the Gates Foundation and being developed with Genesis Analytics, to strengthen strategic planning, resource allocation and evidence-based decision-making.

The UN Volunteer will support the Planning and Budget Management (PBM) unit in improving planning processes, strengthening the application of AI-enabled planning tools and ensuring institutional continuity, complementing existing data management capacity.
Task description
Under the supervision of PBM, the UN Volunteer will:
• Support the review, documentation, and improvement of planning processes, workflows, and tools.
• Assist in translating planning and budget management requirements into functional specifications for digital and AI-enabled solutions.
• Support the application, testing and validation of AI-enabled planning tools, analytical outputs and resource allocation scenarios.
• Assist in identifying functional gaps, documenting user feedback and coordinating improvements to planning tools.
• Support the preparation of planning guidance, user manuals and training materials.
• Contribute to knowledge transfer, documentation and routine operational support for the Strategic Forecasting and Resource Optimization Platform.
• Promote knowledge sharing, collaboration and volunteerism through relevant WHO and UNV activities.
Results / Expected Outputs
• Improved and documented planning processes, workflows and functional requirements.
• Validated AI-enabled planning tools, with documented testing results and improvement recommendations.
• Updated planning guidance, user documentation and knowledge-sharing materials.
• Strengthened institutional capacity to use and sustain planning and analytical tools.
Required experience / skills
A minimum of one year of relevant professional experience in business analysis, planning support, information systems, data analysis or digital solutions.
Required Skills
• Business process analysis, requirements gathering and workflow documentation.
• Working knowledge of Excel, Power BI, SQL or comparable analytical tools.
• Familiarity with digital systems, data validation and user acceptance testing.
• Digital visualisation, communication and problem-solving skills.
Desirable: Familiarity with AI-enabled analytical tools, programme planning, budget management or financial analysis.
Languages
Fluent in English or French, with working knowledge of the other language desirable.
Area(s) of expertise
Data science, information management, Artificial Intelligence
Specialization
Business Information Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Administration, Data Analytics or a related field.
Competencies and values
• Professionalism,
• teamwork,
• planning and organizing,
• analytical thinking and commitment to volunteerism.
Living conditions and remarks

Pays à revenu intermédiaire, le Congo connait un contexte de développement particulièrement favorable avec un cadre macroéconomique stabilisé du fait de la mise en œuvre des réformes macroéconomiques ambitieuses. Sa croissance économique avoisine en moyenne les 6% depuis plus d’une décennie. Cependant, la baisse du prix du baril de pétrole actuel s’il persiste, pourrait entraver cette dynamique. Il est à noter que les performances au niveau macroéconomique contrastent avec les conditions de vie des populations qui demeurent difficiles. Le chômage, particulièrement celui des jeunes demeure élevé et le coût de la vie est assez élevé par rapport à celui des autres pays de la sous-région. Les importations alimentaires assurent l’essentiel de la couverture des besoins des populations au niveau des grandes villes. La paix et la sécurité se sont considérablement améliorées. à Brazzaville, et Pointe – Noire, Niveau 1 au niveau de tout le reste du territoire. Le VNU sera basé à Brazzaville. La ville est calme, la vie quotidienne à Brazzaville est sûre et on peut circuler librement. Les commodités alimentaires et non alimentaires sont disponibles. Les installations médicales sont conformes aux normes. Il est difficile de trouver un appartement convenable avec des conditions de sécurité de base et d'approvisionnement en eau. Les appartements doivent être approuvés par le Département de la sécurité et de la sécurité à Brazzaville. Des missions dans les régions où se trouvent les bénéficiaires sont organisées en fonction des besoins. https://www.unv.org
